name: End Game Arcane Wisdom
author: X
description: End game Arcane Wisdom lineup used in the Taiwanese version.

members.note: Stable damage tank. Consumes [Awakening] stacks to repeatedly cast [Ironclad Surge], turning missing health into massive heals.
Core support. Attaches to the highest-attack ally to make herself untargetable while granting massive shields and damage buffs.
Defensive anchor. Consumes [Awakening] stacks to deal heavy damage and apply defense debuffs with [Crescent Skybreak].
Main sustained DPS. Supercharged by Vivienne, she consumes [Awakening] stacks to double-cast [Luna Arrow] for massive physical damage.
Sustained area DPS. Places mechanical orbs and consumes [Awakening] stacks to deploy more, eventually unleashing them all in the [Wild] state.
Disruption Priest. Stalls enemies by increasing their Overdrive costs and consumes [Awakening] stacks to heal the team via [Mana Surge].

bench.note: Harvests energy. Deals massive execute damage that scales when Arcane Wisdom allies gain [Awakening].
Frontline burst. Consumes [Awakening] stacks to empower her basic attacks with heavy stuns.
Frontline Guardian. Constantly generates self-shields by consuming [Awakening] stacks generated by allied Overdrives.
High-tier Priest utility. Consumes [Awakening] to guarantee her massive team heals and buffs duplicate.
Sustained AoE DPS. Builds [Awakening] stacks to increase the number of fiery vortex hits from her Ultimate.
High-frequency petrification. Steals cooldowns and counters basic attacks with [Venom Mark].
Disruptive tank. Consumes [Awakening] to unleash continuous Spirit Flames that deal area damage and heal her.
Energy recovery Assassin. Consumes [Awakening] stacks to unleash a supercharged [Crippling Strike] on high-energy enemies.

name: End Game Sanctum Glory
author: X
description: End game Sanctum Glory lineup used in the Taiwanese version.

members.note: Area taunt tank. Sacrifices HP to generate massive shields and gathers enemies while protecting vulnerable allies with [Life Link].
Control Priest. Banishes enemies to deal true damage and marks targets to heal allies when they attack them.
Possession immunity and massive damage increase. Attaches to the highest-attack ally to grant massive shields and continuous healing.
Burst tank-shredding. Applies [Sigil of Radiance] to deal massive bonus physical damage based on the target's Max HP.
Group burst damage. Becomes untargetable and unleashes heavy area magic damage slashes, healing herself on critical hits.
Peerless Swordsman. Summons a highly evasive [Sword Clone] that taunts enemies, while dealing massive, untargetable area damage.

bench.note: Early game cost reduction. High-tier Priest that guarantees duplicate heals and buffs.
Generates continuous [Shield of Wisdom] stacks for critical damage boosts. Deals heavy physical damage with [Time Flying Wheel].
Counters dual assassins. Creates a [Spirit Shackles] shield formation for immense damage reduction and crowd control immunity.
Magic orb buffs. Binds to the highest-attack ally to coordinate magic arrows and sacrifices HP for massive team healing and [Morale].
Low-cost interrupt. Provides [Fervor] and [High Morale] to allies while raining down pillars of light on shocked enemies.
Fast activation buffer. Replaces basic attacks to grant continuous [Attack Speed Up] to the strongest ally and team-wide [Adrenaline].

name: End Game Wild Spirit
author: X
description: End game Wild Spirit lineup used in the Taiwanese version.

members.note: Area taunt tank. Redirects incoming damage to herself and provides heavy AoE retaliation that loses its cooldown in the [Wild] state.
Heal block and sustained DPS. Transforms into [Bloodferno Form] to deal heavy damage and steal enemy Healing Received effects.
High-tier Priest. Grants immense Damage Reduction through [Divine Melody] and automatically heals allies when they enter the [Wild] state.
Sustained area DPS. Places mechanical orbs that all activate simultaneously for massive rapid-fire damage when she enters the [Wild] state.
Burst tank-shredding. Reduces enemy Movement Speed with [Endless Edge] and unleashes a rapid five-blade attack in the [Wild] state.
Backline disruptor. Teleports into the enemy team to increase their Overdrive cooldowns and applies [Echoes of Pain] for follow-up damage.

bench.note: Self-sustaining frontline. Converts area damage into extreme health recovery when entering the [Wild] state.
High-tier Priest. Significantly increases damage by possessing the main DPS and granting massive shields.
Ricocheting Archer. Sacrifices HP to bounce attacks between enemies, gaining massive Attack Speed and Lifesteal in the [Wild] state.
High-risk Warrior. Sacrifices health to deal heavy physical damage, becoming significantly more lethal with massive Life Steal in the [Wild] state.
Labyrinth Overlord. Enters the [Wild] state to unleash a relentless [Savage Cyclone], rapidly recovering lost HP in the process.
Counters dual assassins. Enters the [Wild] state to generate powerful shields, heal herself upon dodging, and buff allied Magic Defense.
Magic orb buffs and dispels debuffs. Increases Attack Speed of allied Luminaries in the [Wild] state by 25% while providing massive team healing.
Fast activation buffer. Grants [Attack Speed Up] and [Attack Boost] specifically prioritizing allies in the [Wild] state.

name: End Game Illusion Veil
author: X
description: End game Illusion Veil lineup used in the Taiwanese version.

members.note: Stable tanking. Intercepts projectiles with [Radiant Barrier] and punishes enemies by increasing their Overdrive costs when the barrier breaks.
Disruption Priest. Manipulates enemy energy costs with [Elemental Crucible] and applies [Healing Prohibition] to stall their Overdrives.
Primary burst Mage. Greatly multiplies her damage by applying [Scorching Sun] and inflicts [Ignite] via [Brahma's Fire Dance].
Backline disruptor. Teleports to the enemy center to increase their Overdrive cooldowns and applies [Silence].
Sustained DPS. Safely shreds targets from the backline and increases skill haste and damage for ranged allies via [Dark Moon].
Key death immunity. Provides a critical [Frost Barrier] to save a dying ally and constantly delays enemy Overdrives via [Tide of the Abyss].

bench.note: Continuous control and sustained DPS. Punishes enemies with heavy stuns from [Godfist].
High-mobility Assassin. Heavily punishes displaced enemies by dealing massive additional damage when they are knocked back.
Sustained DPS with Heal block. Increases the target's next Overdrive Energy cost and inflicts [Chill] using [Magic Crystal Arrow].
Sustained DPS and lifesteal. Steals enemy Healing Received effects and sacrifices HP to deal heavy damage.
Iron-Fisted Ruler. Constantly steals ultimate cooldowns from enemies whenever the [Punishment] effect is triggered.
Sustained DPS. Ignores enemy shields and heavily penalizes enemies afflicted with [Corruption and Decay].
High-frequency petrification. Steals cooldowns, delays enemy Overdrives, and counters basic attacks with [Venom Mark].
Energy management and interrupts. Constantly increases enemy Overdrive costs and inflicts [Silence].
Interrupt control. Punishes enemies by increasing their Overdrive costs with [Axe Boomerang] and inflicting [Stun].
High-frequency silence. Specifically targets and suppresses high-energy enemies with [Crippling Strike].

name: End Game Otherworld Return
author: X
description: End game Otherworld Return lineup used in the Taiwanese version.

members.note: Stable tanking. Thrives when allies fall, gaining [Deathrattle] stacks to repeatedly cheat death and recover health.
Backline damage reduction. Summons [Little Devil]s to disrupt enemies and converts summon damage into health via [Blood Thirst].
Duplicates summons. Spawns [Tentacle]s for continuous damage/healing and scales her health permanently as summons die.
Universal front-line protection. Scales her Damage Reduction or Amplification based on shields and provides massive team-wide shields.
Permanent chain seal. Becomes invincible at low health, summons mirror images, and permanently seals enemy special abilities.
Burst tank-shredding. Scales her Attack drastically as allies fall by accumulating [Deathrattle] stacks.

bench.note: Control Priest. Uses [Deathrattle] stacks to pull vulnerable allies to safety and grant them massive shields.
Harvests energy recovery. Uses [Deathrattle] stacks to block fatal damage, cleanse debuffs, and recover massive health.
Stable damage absorption. Gains [Deathrattle] stacks as allies fall, immensely increasing her Crit Resist.
Peerless Swordsman. Her massive evasion rate scales directly with the number of [Deathrattle] stacks she accumulates.
Sustained DPS. Gains [Deathrattle] stacks and increases her chance to delay enemy ultimates when attacking afflicted targets.
Delays Overdrives and petrifies enemies. Uses [Deathrattle] stacks to increase her chance of unleashing additional Broken Arrows.
Black Cat Goddess. Summons an army of Mummies whose inherited Attack scales up for every [Deathrattle] stack she gains.

name: End Game Elemental Echo
author: X
description: End game Elemental Echo lineup used in the Taiwanese version.

members.note: Evasion tank. Teammates gain increased damage and reduced damage whenever they successfully apply [Shock] to enemies.
High [Ignite] coverage. Rapidly stacks [Scorching Sun] to multiply her damage whenever an ally triggers [Detonation] or [Evaporation].
High burst damage. Applies [Thor's Mark] to enemies afflicted with [Shock], later detonating them for massive AoE magic damage.
Sustained DPS and [Grievous Wounds]. Gains a massive Attack boost against enemies currently suffering from [Elemental Reaction]s.
Critical death immunity. All of her skills apply [Chill], and she deals massive bonus magic damage whenever she triggers an [Elemental Reaction].
High-tier Priest. Automatically heals allies for a massive chunk of their Max HP every time they trigger an [Elemental Reaction].

bench.note: Highly mobile Assassin. Rapidly gains Energy to fuel her Overdrive whenever allies trigger [Ignite].
High-tier Priest. Grants a massive damage buff and continuous healing to the main DPS while supplementing with [Chill].
Sustained DPS. Continuously applies [Ignite] via firestorms and reduces her own Overdrive costs upon triggering reactions.
Stable damage mitigation. Applies [Ignite] in her Wild state and debuffs enemy attack power whenever she triggers reactions.
Queen of the North. Creates a massive [Frost Vortex] to heavily slow enemies and punish [Chill]ed targets.
Reaction enabler. Automatically applies [Chill] the exact moment an ally inflicts [Ignite] or [Shock].
Chain crowd control. Deals devastating execute damage to enemies already afflicted with [Chill], [Flash Freeze], or [Evaporation].
Evasive Guardian. Becomes near-untouchable against elementally-debuffed enemies and periodically heals the team on every reaction.
